observations: Photo 0 shows a pair of clear-lens headlamp assemblies lying on a tiled floor, each with visible mounting brackets and electrical connector tabs.
Photo 1 shows a front grille with chrome-trimmed slats and a Toyota oval emblem in the center, also on a tiled floor.
No taillight unit is visible in either photo, despite the seller's text mentioning a 'taillight'.
No part numbers, VIN stickers, or 'Prado' model markings are legible in either photo.
Both parts show some grime and wear consistent with used, removed-from-vehicle parts; no obvious cracks are visible from the angles shown.

identity.kind: SUV front grille and pair of headlamp assemblies

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and taillight in working condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows headlamp assemblies, not taillights; 'Prado' model is not confirmed by any visible marking; 'working condition' cannot be seen in a still photo.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: Toyota oval badge is visible on the grille in photo 1, but no part number or stamping is legible to confirm OEM origin; headlamps show no brand markings at all.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Only front/top angles are shown; rear of grille and underside/back of headlamps (where clips and cracks are most likely) are not visible.

risks.risk: Mismatch between advertised parts (grille + taillight) and photographed parts (grille + headlamps) could mean wrong item sent or misleading listing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual taillight unit being sold, alongside the grille and headlamps.
risks.if_unproven: priced as grille and headlamps only, with no taillight included

risks.risk: Parts could be aftermarket/China copy despite the Toyota badge, which is easy to swap onto non-OEM housings.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of molded part numbers or Toyota casting marks on the plastic housing of both grille and headlamps.

risks.risk: Headlamp bulbs, wiring, or leveling motors may not function even though the lens and housing look intact.
risks.proof: A short video of each headlamp powered on and lit.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, chips, or broken clips on the underside/back of the grille or headlamps not visible in current angles.
risks.proof: Additional photos from the rear and underside of each part, including all mounting clips.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual taillight unit referenced in the listing text
Close-up photos of any molded part numbers or Toyota casting marks on grille and headlamp housings
Video of both headlamps powered on and illuminated
Photos of the rear/underside of the grille and headlamps showing all clips and brackets
response.reason: No comparable listings exist for this kind of item, and the seller's own description (taillight) does not match what is shown in the photos (headlamps), so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without further proof.
